newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rayonier, Fletcher NZ units in mdf supply deal.
newsitem.headline: Rayonier, Fletcher NZ units in mdf supply deal.

text.p: Rayonier Inc 's New Zealand unit Rayonier New Zealand said on Wednesday it had sealed a supply and marketing deal with a unit of Fletcher Challenge Building, covering sales of RNZ-manufactured medium density fibreboard (mdf) in New Zealand.

In a statement RNZ said the agreement covered around 10 to 15 percent of the planned production from its new NZ$180 million plant at Mataura in the southern South Island, where annual output is expected to be in the region of 140,000 cubic metres.

Fletcher will use established distribution channels to serve the New Zealand market with the product line, which complements its own Lakepine-branded range, and the RNZ product will be branded Lakepine as well.
RNZ will concentrate its efforts on the export markets for which the Mataura plant had been designed, it said.
Fletcher unit Fletcher Wood Panels markets board through its Scott Panel & Hardware and Placemakers retail chains, which have a significant share of the market for this type of product.
RNZ said it plans to export most of the new plant's mdf to Japan, Taiwan, Southeast Asian countries and Australia.
The Rayonier group has 600,000 hectares of timber in the United States and New Zealand, with about 60 percent of its sales to international markets.
